readerCopy.headline: The plan can grow without collapsing under its own weight.
readerCopy.body:
A careful investment of time or effort may finally start paying because the foundation is already there. You may be able to take on more without the rest of the week falling apart. The sequence makes sense. The responsibility has somewhere to go.

Jupiter trine Saturn is useful for building the version you can keep. Use the easier conditions to commit, finish, or add the next level. Do not spend the whole favorable window perfecting what is already ready enough to use.
doNotAssume: Do not assume permanent stability, financial success, or that growth must be slow.
